purpose: Specify a bounded SQLite L_RT durability reference for supplied exact M0 EffectIntent values.
owned_mechanism: Generation and compare-and-swap lease fencing, including a second fence check before receipt/checkpoint commit after external I/O
Exact M4AApprovalRequestPreimage and M4AApprovalPreimage recomputation plus atomic one-time approval consumption, EffectIntent persistence, receipt binding, checkpoint update, and outbox insertion
Attempt persistence before adapter I/O and destination reconciliation before retry after uncertain or started attempts

Retry exhaustion persists a reconcile/retry_exhausted outbox handoff before destination query; a not-applied query then persists retry_exhausted_not_applied before a confirmed_failure receipt, while an unproven result persists human_reconciliation without automatic retry

Exact frozen M0 ActionReceipt construction from committed command/input/platform binding, explicit output/trace/outcome observation, and RFC 3339 conversion of the injected epoch clock under flrh-cjson/1 canonicalization
Atomic receipt, attempt observation or disposition, checkpoint, and outbox persistence; checkpoint quarantine; and reproducible no-progress windows that cannot terminalize with pending effects

Pending interrupts are typed-idempotent, reject new effects and rounds, but permit reconcile/dispatch recovery of already-committed effects before the interrupt is honored; terminal runs reject new interrupts
Per-run max_pending and max_attempts bounds capped by profile ceilings 1024 and 16
Independent verification checks every attempt transition and orphan approvals; the SQLite approval-to-intent link is deferred but foreign-key constrained
Exact ordered manifest closure with SHA-256 pins for inherited M0 canonical/protocol and semantic M4A dependencies

effect_semantics.duplicate_rule: exact stable bytes are idempotent; same identity with different bytes conflicts
effect_semantics.unknown_rule: query destination evidence before any retry

retry_exhaustion.attempt_boundary: no attempt is created beyond max_attempts
retry_exhaustion.pre_disposition: persist outbox status reconcile and route retry_exhausted, then query destination evidence
retry_exhaustion.confirmed_success: persist an exact M0 ActionReceipt with outcome confirmed_success
retry_exhaustion.confirmed_not_applied: persist attempt status reconciled_not_applied and outbox route retry_exhausted_not_applied before constructing an exact confirmed_failure receipt; then retain done outbox route retry_exhausted
retry_exhaustion.unproven: persist attempt status unknown and outbox route human_reconciliation; stop automatic query and dispatch
retry_exhaustion.outer_boundary: leave the M4B run active; the outer run FSM owns RETRIES_EXHAUSTED and any terminal transition

completion_boundary: PROPOSED simulated SQLite and FakeAdapter evidence only. M4B accepts exact schema-shaped M0 EffectIntent values but does not establish their policy correctness, integrated FLR behavior, real-destination safety, production readiness, comparative efficacy, or engine promotion.
